train_eval_model: train or evaluate a model with data, labels, and batch graph using cross-entropy loss
smooth_one_hot_labels: apply label smoothing to integer labels by converting them to a smoothed probability distribution
cal_performance_loss: calculate cross-entropy loss, number of correct predictions, and total word count for sequence data
pk_sim_pairwise: compute positive and negative pairwise cosine similarity scores from code vectors for p classes and k samples
map_at_r_metric: compute the mean average precision at R metric from a similarity matrix and program IDs
